metadata.name: nucleus
metadata.description: Permissionless isolated lending protocol on Solana

accounts.name: loan_vault
docs: Source: market's loan vault (protocol lends from here)

accounts.name: collateral_oracle
docs: Collateral price oracle — needed for post-borrow health check

accounts.name: loan_oracle
docs: Loan price oracle — or stablecoin $1 if market.loan_oracle_feed_id == [0u8; 32]

accounts.name: position
docs: The fee_recipient's position in this market.
If it doesn't exist, the caller must create it first via create_position.

accounts.name: loan_vault
docs: Destination: market's loan vault (receives repayment + fee)

accounts.name: liquidator_loan_ata
docs: Source (debt repayment): liquidator's loan token account

accounts.name: liquidator_collateral_ata
docs: Destination (collateral seizure): liquidator's collateral token account

accounts.name: loan_oracle
docs: Loan price oracle (or stablecoin $1 if market.loan_oracle_feed_id == [0u8; 32])

accounts.name: position
docs: The borrower whose debt to repay (may differ from repayer — anyone can repay)

accounts.name: supplier_loan_ata
docs: Source: supplier's loan token account (e.g. USDC wallet)

accounts.name: market
docs: Market account (read-only for pause check; collateral ops work even when paused)

accounts.name: market
docs: Market state — mutable because we accrue interest before the health check

accounts.name: irm
docs: IRM account needed for interest accrual

accounts.name: collateral_oracle
docs: Collateral price oracle (StaticOracle for localnet; Pyth on mainnet Day 5)
Only read if position has debt.

accounts.name: loan_oracle
docs: Loan price oracle (StaticOracle for localnet; Pyth on mainnet Day 5)
Only read if position has debt AND market.loan_oracle_feed_id != [0u8; 32].

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: caller is not the protocol owner

errors.name: InvalidLltv
errors.msg: LLTV value is invalid (must be 0 < lltv < 10000)

errors.name: LltvNotEnabled
errors.msg: LLTV is not enabled in protocol state

errors.name: IrmNotEnabled
errors.msg: IRM is not enabled in protocol state

errors.name: PositionUnhealthy
errors.msg: Position is unhealthy after this operation

errors.name: PositionHealthy
errors.msg: Position is healthy and cannot be liquidated

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.msg: Invalid input: specify exactly one of assets or shares

errors.name: OracleFeedMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle feed ID does not match market configuration

errors.name: FlashLoanCallerMismatch
errors.msg: Flash loan caller does not match the starter

errors.name: FlashLoanAmountMismatch
errors.msg: Flash loan repayment amount does not match the borrowed principal

types.name: LinearIrm
docs: Below kink: rate = base_rate + slope1 * utilization / WAD
Above kink: rate = base_rate + slope1 * kink / WAD + slope2 * (utilization - kink) / WAD
All rates are stored as per-second rates, WAD-scaled.

fields.name: slope1
docs: Slope of the rate curve below the kink, per second, WAD-scaled
Example: for 5% APY slope → 5 * WAD / 100 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR

fields.name: slope2
docs: Slope of the rate curve above the kink, per second, WAD-scaled

fields.name: collateral_oracle_feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed ID for collateral/USD

fields.name: loan_oracle_feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed ID for loan/USD (all zeros = assume $1 for stablecoins)

fields.name: total_supply_assets
docs: Total loan token assets supplied (grows with interest)

fields.name: total_borrow_assets
docs: Total loan tokens borrowed (grows with interest)

fields.name: flash_loan_amount
docs: Amount borrowed in the active flash loan, if any

fields.name: flash_loan_caller
docs: Caller that initiated the active flash loan

fields.name: market_id
docs: Market ID this position belongs to

fields.name: collateral
docs: Raw collateral token amount (not interest-bearing, tracks exact deposited amount)

fields.name: owner
docs: Protocol admin who can enable LLTVs, IRMs, set fees, pause

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Address that receives protocol fee shares

fields.name: paused
docs: Global pause flag — blocks supply, borrow, collateral operations

types.name: StaticOracle
docs: Static oracle account for localnet testing and devnet demos.
On mainnet, oracle prices come from Pyth PriceUpdateV2 accounts (Day 5).
This account lets us set arbitrary prices in tests and stage liquidation scenarios.
price_wad = USD value per **base unit** (smallest denomination), WAD-scaled (1e18)

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Feed ID — must match market.collateral_oracle_feed_id or loan_oracle_feed_id

fields.name: price_wad
docs: USD price per base unit, WAD-scaled

fields.name: admin
docs: Only this account can update the price

fields.name: last_update
docs: Unix timestamp of last price update (for staleness checks)
